Jul 22, 2024

Recap of The First Ever Playmakers Cup!

The inaugural Playmakers Cup brought 62 boys' and girls' teams from across California to Central Park for more than 100 games and crowned champions across 10 divisions.

By Playmaker Sports

The first Playmakers Cup brought 62 boys' and girls' teams from across California to Central Park for more than 100 games. Ten divisions crowned champions during a landmark weekend for Playmaker Sports.

The inaugural tournament was created to give clubs a competitive, well-organized event while making the weekend enjoyable for families. From the first group matches to the final awards, the venue carried the energy of teams building a new tournament tradition together.

Players competed hard across every division, and coaches, referees, volunteers, and staff helped keep a demanding schedule moving. The support from participating clubs made the first edition possible and provided a strong foundation for future events.

Thank you to everyone who joined us for the beginning of the Playmakers Cup. We are excited to keep improving the experience and welcome more of the soccer community in the years ahead.
